signals_info.description: Ego-vehicle speed in the intersection scene.

nl_Literal_translation_en: From 1 to 5 seconds from now, the ego vehicle speed shall remain below 30 kilometers per hour.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从现在起第 1 秒到第 5 秒之间，自车速度应始终低于 30 千米每小时。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During the intersection traversal window from the first through the fifth second, the vehicle shall continuously remain below 30 km/h.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在第 1 秒至第 5 秒的路口通行窗口内，车辆速度应持续低于 30 千米每小时。
